description:
About our brand and products

The Beauty Corner is a professional beauty retailer serving customers across the United States and the Caribbean. We curate trusted salon-quality brands and professional beauty solutions across haircare, skincare, wellness, oral care, and beauty tools.

What makes us different

We focus on professional-grade products recommended by beauty experts, stylists, and salon professionals. Our goal is to connect customers with trusted brands and education-driven recommendations.

How affiliates can earn

Affiliates earn a 10% commission on qualified sales generated through their affiliate links and coupon codes. We offer a 30-day tracking cookie and flexible payout options.

How to promote us

Affiliates can share products through content creation, social media, blogs, email marketing, beauty communities, salon recommendations, and educational beauty content.

Other information

Applications are reviewed manually to ensure alignment with The Beauty Network community and brand values.
payout_period: Commissions are reviewed and approved after orders are completed. Payments are processed upon request once the minimum payout threshold is reached.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to The Beauty Network by The Beauty Corner.

Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program. These Terms & Conditions apply to all individuals, creators, stylists, salon professionals, businesses, or entities participating in The Beauty Network Affiliate Program.

In these Terms & Conditions, “The Beauty Corner,”, "TBC", “we,” “us,” or “merchant” refers to The Beauty Corner. “You,” “your,” or “affiliate” refers to the person or entity applying to or participating in the Program.

By applying to or participating in the Program, you agree to follow these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with them in full, you may not register as an affiliate or participate in the Program.

For questions, please contact: shop@thebeautycorner.shop

1. Program Overview

The Beauty Network is an affiliate program created by The Beauty Corner to partner with trusted beauty voices who share our products with their audiences, clients, and communities.

Approved affiliates may receive a personal affiliate link and may earn commissions from eligible purchases made through that link, subject to these Terms & Conditions.

Participation in the Program does not create an employment, agency, franchise, joint venture, legal partnership, or exclusive relationship between you and The Beauty Corner.

2. Approval or Rejection of Applications

We reserve the right to approve or reject any affiliate application at our sole discretion.

We may consider factors such as audience fit, content quality, brand alignment, location, promotional channels, and overall suitability for The Beauty Network.

Submitting an application does not guarantee approval. If your application is rejected, you will not have legal recourse against The Beauty Corner for that decision.

3. Eligible Territories

Affiliate commissions apply only to eligible orders placed in territories where The Beauty Corner currently offers shipping, delivery, or order fulfillment.

If a customer places an order from a location where The Beauty Corner does not ship or cannot fulfill the order, that transaction may be cancelled, refunded, or deemed ineligible for commission.


The Beauty Corner may update its shipping territories at any time based on operational, carrier, customs, inventory, or business limitations.

4. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Once approved, your affiliate link will be automatically generated through the affiliate platform. You may also be able to create affiliate links for specific products, collections, or pages available on The Beauty Corner website.

If a customer clicks more than one affiliate link, the most recent eligible affiliate link clicked before purchase will be the one credited, according to the platform’s tracking rules.

Affiliates may or may not receive a personal or branded coupon code. If a coupon code is assigned to you, the details, usage rules, and restrictions will be available in your affiliate dashboard or communicated by The Beauty Corner.

If a customer clicks your affiliate link and also uses your coupon code, you will not receive double commission for the same order. Only one commission may be credited per eligible purchase.

If you have not been assigned an official coupon code, you may not promote, publish, create, or claim any coupon code as your own or as approved by The Beauty Corner.

Affiliates may promote The Beauty Corner through approved online and offline channels, including social media, websites, blogs, email, WhatsApp, salon recommendations, client follow-ups, print materials, magazines, or other appropriate promotional channels.

All promotional activity must be truthful, brand-aligned, and compliant with these Terms & Conditions.

5. Cookie Duration

The Program uses a 30-day cookie window.

This means that if a customer clicks your affiliate link and completes an eligible purchase within 30 days, the purchase may be credited to you, provided the order is properly tracked and meets all Program requirements.

Affiliate tracking depends on cookies, browser settings, device settings, and platform functionality. If cookies are blocked, cleared, disabled, or otherwise unavailable, The Beauty Corner may not be able to track the referral and no commission may be earned.

If the customer clears cookies, uses another device or browser, clicks another affiliate link, or if tracking fails for any reason, the purchase may not be credited to you.

6. Commission Rate

Approved affiliates may earn a 10% commission on eligible completed purchases attributed to their affiliate link.

Commission is calculated based on the eligible order subtotal, excluding taxes, shipping fees, duties, gift cards, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, returned items, cancelled orders, or any other non-commissionable amounts.

The Beauty Corner reserves the right to review, adjust, approve, reject, or reverse commissions at its discretion when necessary.

7. Payment Methods

Affiliate payments may be issued through one of the following available methods:

  • PayPal
  • Store credit at The Beauty Corner

Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment information in the affiliate dashboard. The Beauty Corner is not responsible for delayed, failed, or misdirected payments caused by incorrect payment details.

Store credit, if selected or issued, may be subject to separate store credit terms, expiration rules, or usage limitations.

Payment schedules, minimum payout thresholds, and payout approval timelines may be displayed in the affiliate dashboard or communicated by The Beauty Corner.

8. Approved Commissions, Returns, and Refunds

Commissions are only payable on transactions that are successfully completed, tracked, approved, and not refunded, cancelled, charged back, or returned.

If an order is partially refunded, the commission may be adjusted based on the final eligible order value.

If an order is fully refunded, cancelled, fraudulent, or charged back, the commission may be removed or reversed.

The Beauty Corner reserves the right to review each referral order before approving commission payment.

9. Marketing Materials

The Beauty Corner may provide approved marketing assets, product images, logos, banners, campaign materials, product focuses, or promotional guidelines through the affiliate platform or other communication channels.

Affiliates may use these materials only for the purpose of promoting The Beauty Corner in connection with the Program.

You may not alter logos, make unsupported claims, misrepresent products, imply exclusivity, or present yourself as an employee or official representative of The Beauty Corner.

All content must reflect The Beauty Corner’s positioning as a professional beauty retailer with a curated, trustworthy point of view.

10. Affiliate Disclosure and Compliance

Affiliates must clearly disclose their relationship with The Beauty Corner whenever sharing affiliate links, sponsored content, gifted products, paid recommendations, or any content where a material connection exists.

Disclosures must be clear, easy to notice, and placed where customers can see them before or at the time they engage with the affiliate link or recommendation.

Examples of acceptable disclosure language may include:

  1. “I may earn a commission when you shop through my link.”
  2. “Affiliate link: I may earn from qualifying purchases.”
  3. “Partnered with The Beauty Corner.”
  4. “#ad” or “#affiliate,” when clearly visible and appropriate for the platform.

Affiliates are responsible for complying with all applicable laws, platform rules, advertising standards, and disclosure requirements in their country, state, or territory.

11. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates may not engage in any activity that is misleading, fraudulent, abusive, or harmful to The Beauty Corner, its customers, or its brand partners.

Prohibited activities include, but are not limited to:

  1. Using false, exaggerated, or unsupported product claims
  2. Misrepresenting The Beauty Corner, its products, pricing, shipping, availability, or promotions
  3. Promoting unauthorized coupon codes
  4. Bidding on The Beauty Corner branded keywords in paid search without written approval
  5. Using spam, unsolicited messages, or misleading email practices
  6. Creating fake orders, self-referrals, or fraudulent transactions
  7. Using bots, cookie stuffing, forced clicks, pop-ups, redirects, or deceptive tracking methods
  8. Posting affiliate links on coupon abuse sites or unauthorized deal platforms
  9. Impersonating The Beauty Corner or any of its brand partners
  10. Registering domains, social media handles, ads, or pages that imitate The Beauty Corner
  11. Using offensive, discriminatory, illegal, explicit, or inappropriate content to promote the Program

Violation of this section may result in removal from the Program and forfeiture of pending commissions.

12. Product Claims and Brand Representation

Affiliates must only make accurate, truthful, and supportable statements about The Beauty Corner and the products sold on our website.

You may share your personal experience, routine, or recommendation, but you may not make medical, clinical, guaranteed, or exaggerated claims unless those claims are officially supported by the brand or The Beauty Corner.

Affiliates should not state or imply that any product will diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition unless such claim is expressly authorized and legally permitted.

13. Intellectual Property

The Beauty Corner name, logo, website content, product images, campaign assets, and related brand materials are owned by The Beauty Corner or its respective partners.

Affiliates may use approved assets only for Program-related promotion.

You may not register domains, social media handles, ads, pages, or accounts that use or closely imitate The Beauty Corner’s name, trademarks, or brand identity without written permission.

14. Order Eligibility

Only valid, completed, and trackable orders placed through The Beauty Corner’s website may be eligible for commission.

Orders may be ineligible for commission if they are:

  • Cancelled
  • Refunded
  • Returned
  • Fraudulent
  • Placed outside eligible shipping territories
  • Not properly tracked
  • Linked to unauthorized coupon activity
  • Created through self-referral or artificial activity
  • In violation of these Terms & Conditions

The Beauty Corner has final discretion over commission eligibility.

15. Taxes and Affiliate Responsibilities

Affiliates are responsible for any taxes, fees, reporting requirements, or legal obligations related to income earned through the Program.

The Beauty Corner may request tax forms, identification, payment details, or additional documentation before issuing payment where required.

Failure to provide required information may delay or prevent payment.

16. Program Changes

The Beauty Corner may update, pause, modify, or terminate the Program at any time.

This includes changes to commission rates, cookie duration, payout methods, eligible territories, approval criteria, promotional rules, or any other Program terms.

Any changes may apply immediately or on a date communicated by The Beauty Corner.

Continued participation in the Program after changes are made means you accept the updated Terms & Conditions.

17. Removal From the Program

The Beauty Corner may remove any affiliate from the Program at any time, with or without notice, if we believe the affiliate has violated these Terms & Conditions or is no longer aligned with the Program.

Affiliates may also request removal from the Program by contacting: shop@thebeautycorner.shop

Upon removal, you must stop using The Beauty Corner affiliate links, promotional materials, logos, and any Program-related assets.

Pending commissions may be reviewed and may be paid, adjusted, or forfeited depending on the reason for removal and the status of referred orders.

18. Limitation of Liability

The Beauty Corner is not responsible for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages related to participation in the Program.

We do not guarantee that affiliate links, tracking, dashboards, payouts, or the Program platform will be uninterrupted, error-free, or always available.

Affiliate earnings are not guaranteed.

19. Acceptance of Terms

By applying to or participating in The Beauty Network Affiliate Program, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms & Conditions.

We’re excited to have you as part of The Beauty Network!
